engine_defects.defect: cfl_timestep uses each parcel's material sound speed (p.sound_speed) even when scene.eos is 'isothermal' or 'ideal'; continuum_step itself uses scene.sound_speed_m_s for those EOSs (line 741)
engine_defects.evidence: design run A: water_ice material c = 4354 m/s gives dt = 6.89e-6 for a c_s = 1 gas (0.3 h / c_s = 0.03, 4354x larger); 2000 steps cover 0.014 H/c_s and the gas has not left free fall

engine_defects.defect: continuum_step resolves SPH ground contact with the rigid-body resolve_sphere_plane: velocity impulse with restitution 0.5 plus a position correction y -> y + 0.8 (r - y - 0.001) that pulls every penetrating parcel toward one height; resting fluid on the floor never comes to rest, and in a planar column the corrected parcels become bitwise coincident
engine_defects.evidence: no run reaches KE < 1e-4 of peak (floors 7e-4 to 4.5e-3); where per-parcel KE was saved, 99.9-99.99 % of the residual KE sits in parcels within 2 r of the floor once the column is quiet (E0 = C2 replica, C8, 3-D D), 98 % in the h/H 0.1 replica E1 and 20 % in C7, which was still oscillating; the free atmosphere of E0 falls to 4e-9 of peak;C1/C2: 19 and 33 parcels at bitwise-identical y = 0.01874 / 0.01842; 3-D: 79 of 200 parcels in the floor layer

engine_defects.defect: grad_W returns (0,0,0) for r < L_PLANCK, so coincident parcels exert no pressure force on each other and never separate; together with the cubic spline pairing instability at high neighbour number (Dehnen & Aly 2012, arXiv:1204.2471) parcels in the dense lower column collapse into near-coincident pairs and clumps
engine_defects.evidence: C1 final: clumps at y = 0.1393 with gaps 3e-17; C2: gaps 1e-11 to 1e-10 between paired parcels; up to 49 of 256 parcels in merged clumps (C3)

design_corrections: cfl_timestep is not the isothermal CFL: the design's "2000 steps at cfl_timestep (80 s)" covers 0.014 H/c_s (dt = 6.9e-6); corrected runs use 0.3 h / max(c_s, v_max), the engine formula with the isothermal c_s

the 1 x 4 x 1 H box has no side walls: the gas spreads sideways (lateral std 25.9 H by t = 30) and never forms a column; corrected by a planar column (all parcels on x = z = 0, laterally confined by symmetry, unmodified engine) and by a 3-D lateral-periodic image tiling

N = 128 in a 1 x 4 x 1 box at h = 0.1 H gives a mean of 0.94 neighbours: the SPH density is the self-term m W(0); 3-D at h/H 0.1-0.2 needs N ~ 1e3-1e4 per H^2 of footprint (9x that with periodic images), beyond pure-Python cost

the predicted resolution trend is reversed: at fixed N a larger h means more neighbours, so h/H = 0.2 is the clean case (1.002) and h/H = 0.1 the marginal one (oscillating +/-4 %, pairing); h/H = 0.05 fails (1.27, 2 neighbours at the window top)
the KE < 1e-4 settle criterion cannot be met with a GroundPlane floor: the parcels resting on it chatter; measured on the free atmosphere only (post hoc) the h/H = 0.2 column reaches 4e-9 of peak

my scaling control (fixed absolute h, g in 0.5/1/2) confounds g with h/H: slope -1.17 fails because the g = 0.5 point is under-resolved, not because H deviates from c_s^2/g (its cumulative-mass H is 0.97 H)
